intro.title: Information Technology
intro.description: Hart County Information Technology supports the technology systems, networks, software, and digital services used throughout county government.

overview: Hart County continues to expand and modernize its technology infrastructure to help employees work more efficiently and provide better service to the public.
The Information Technology department is responsible for county networking, computers, software, and technology purchasing.
High-speed network connections at the Administrative Building and Courthouse improve upload and download performance while supporting more efficient county operations.
responsibilities: Determines and implements standards and decisions regarding changes to networks, systems, and applications, and provides technical expertise.
Manages vendor relationships to maximize value to the County and negotiates technology-related contracts.
Provides enabling technologies to improve the performance of County processes and reduce costs.
Manages information systems activities including IT infrastructure and architecture, applications development, networks, computer operations, and troubleshooting and support for employees.
Provides Internet access to public records for the County and Hart County residents.
Manages the development of internal information technology to ensure productive use of existing and new systems.
Develops, maintains, and updates the Hart County website.
